+## Findings / Blockers

+### F1 — `pg-prod-suite-policy` is RED from a clean checkout (false-green skip path) — NOT-RESOLVED
+`tests/multi-instance.js` prints `⏭️ store موجود نیست` and **exits 0** when the gitignored artifact `server/data/payesh.json` is absent (`.gitignore:29 → server/data/`). The policy gate spawns exactly that suite and asserts `status !== 0` + the `production: DATABASE_URL required` message, so on a clean checkout it reports:
+
+```
+pg-prod-suite-policy: 7/9  FAILED: 1e without DATABASE_URL it does NOT exit 0 (no false green) | 1f the refusal is the production DATABASE_URL gate
+```
+
+After `node server/seed.js` the same gate is **9/9**. ⇒ The gate that exists to prevent "a production boot that exits 0" is itself **not reproducible from a clean checkout**, and the skip-with-0 path it guards against is still present. This is the same class of defect the repo already fixed once for the live-PG suites ("the harness used to be created ad hoc in the sandbox and evaporated on every reset" — `tests/helpers/boot-pg.js` header). Owner: P0-1 package owner (Chat 6/1) — not Chat5 (no code changes in this mission).
